title: Building his first bass from a soapbox and barrel
summary: He recounts making a bass from a soapbox with twine, marking strings in pencil, getting a tuning key, and later building one from a barrel.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
